>_ Episode 5 · Aug 6, 2026 · 1h 5m

Did Richard Dawkins confuse Sycophancy for Sentience?

Play Episode 5 on YouTube
Watch on YouTube SpotifyApple Podcasts

In this episode of Philosophy, Programs and Prompts, Casey (@OntologyExplained) and Carl (@InternetOfBugs) break down Richard Dawkins’ recent article detailing his conversations with Claude ("Claudia"). They explore the nature of personhood, the limits of the Turing Test, evolutionary perspectives on consciousness, and why LLM ego-stroking might be leading smart people astray.
